visual_tokens: SOURCE: concept-bundle/bundle/app_phone/index.html (333 lines, document <title> "Crew dashboard canvas — phone") + screenshot page2.png (878x1899 px = the 390x844 frame at about 2.25x). The board is a STATIC mockup: its <script type="text/x-dc"> is only `class Component extends DCLogic { renderVals() { return {}; } }` with data-props {"$preview":{"width":390,"height":844}}. It has no {{bindings}}, no <sc-if>/<sc-for>, no state, no handlers and no accent prop. The desktop board's accent prop (options #0E153E / #BD2025 / #5B6080) is NOT present here.
Page/canvas background: oklch(0.975 0.006 275), set on both body and the 390x844 frame.

Canvas dot grid: background-image radial-gradient(oklch(0.84 0.018 275) 1px, transparent 1px); background-size 24px 24px; background-position 12px 12px. The grid is drawn on the fixed frame and shows behind all widgets.
Surface (widget cards, context sheet, main bar): oklch(0.998 0.002 275).
Hairline border (widget border, widget header bottom border, sheet border, main bar border, Deselect button border): 1px solid oklch(0.9 0.012 275).
Strong border: oklch(0.84 0.018 275). Used for unselected routine chips (1px solid) and the dot-grid dots.
Soft tint / selected fill: oklch(0.93 0.03 275). Used for the selected chip background, the Insight widget background, the progress track and the 'Synergy' pill background.
Insight widget border and header divider: 1px solid oklch(0.86 0.04 275).

Ink / primary text / accent: #0E153E. Used for body text, link color, the selected chip border and text, the 2px selection ring, the progress fill, the avatar fill, the Insight kicker, the 'Widget' kicker in the sheet, the Insight drag-handle fill and the <strong> partner name.
Link hover: #09102E (global rule a:hover{color:#09102E}).
Muted text: oklch(0.5 0.035 275). Used for meta lines, the header meta '340 / 500', inactive tool and main-bar icons and labels, and the Deselect icon.
Drag-handle dots (unselected widgets): fill oklch(0.68 0.025 275).
Action red: #BD2025. Used for the primary tool fill ('Confirm'), the main-bar Start button fill and the Sharing badge dot. White (#fff) text and icons sit on red and on the ink avatar.
Shadows: context sheet box-shadow 0 10px 30px rgba(14,21,62,0.14); main bar box-shadow 0 10px 30px rgba(14,21,62,0.10). Widgets have no shadow.
Radii: 12px on every card, chip, pill, tool button, main-bar button, progress track and fill, and the badge dot. 999px (full circle) on the avatar and the Deselect button.

Font family: Manrope, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif. @font-face blocks are declared for weights 500, 600, 700 and 800, font-display swap, each with subsets cyrillic-ext, cyrillic, greek, vietnamese, latin-ext and latin. All weights point at the same 6 woff2 files, so it is a variable font. Weight 400 is NOT declared, so unweighted text (paragraphs, meta) renders with the nearest loaded face. Global rule: button{font:inherit;cursor:pointer}.
Base type: frame font-size 15px, line-height 1.5, color #0E153E.

Type scale on phone: widget title 15px/800; Insight kicker 12px/800 uppercase letter-spacing 0.05em #0E153E; Insight headline 16px/800 line-height 1.35; Insight body 14px (inherited weight); routine chip 14px/700; list row title 15px/700 (inherits 15px); meta and caption 13px muted; header meta 13px muted; pill 12px/700; avatar initials 13px/800 white; sheet header 12px/800 with a 'Widget' kicker in uppercase, letter-spacing 0.06em, #0E153E; tool and main-bar labels 10px/700.

Spacing: frame padding 56px top, 20px left/right, 0 bottom; column gap between header row and widgets 20px; widget header padding 12px 14px with a 10px gap between handle and title; widget body padding 14px (Start), 12px 14px 14px (Insight, Tier); Start body inner gap 12px; Insight body gap 6px; Tier body gap 8px; chip gap 8px; list row padding 8px 14px, min-height 54px, gap 10px; pill padding 3px 9px.
Chip geometry: inline-flex, height 40px, padding 0 14px, radius 12px, 1px border.
Progress bar: height 8px, radius 12px, track oklch(0.93 0.03 275), fill #0E153E at 68% width with radius 12px. role=progressbar, aria-label 'Tier progress', aria-valuenow 68, min 0, max 100.

Selection ring: an absolutely positioned overlay (inset 0, border 2px solid #0E153E, radius 12px, pointer-events none) inside the widget section, which is position: relative. The desktop board also defines a guide/hover ring '0 0 0 3px oklch(0.998 0.002 275), 0 0 0 6px #0E153E', but it is not used on phone.

Icons: 24x24 viewBox, stroke currentColor, stroke-width 1.75, round caps and joins. Exceptions: Check and X use stroke-width 2; Play and More are filled. Sizes: sheet tool icons 20px, main-bar icons 22px, Deselect X 16px, drag handle 16px (16x16 viewBox).
Icon path: drag handle = 6 circles r1.5 at (5,3) (11,3) (5,8) (11,8) (5,13) (11,13).
Icon path: check = 'M20 6L9 17l-5-5'.
Icon path: clock (Past, History) = 'M12 22a10 10 0 1 0 0-20 10 10 0 0 0 0 20zM12 6v6l4 2'.
Icon path: X (Deselect) = 'M18 6L6 18M6 6l12 12'.
Icon path: play (Start) = 'M7 4l13 8-13 8z', filled.
Icon path: more = 3 filled circles r2 at (5,12) (12,12) (19,12).

Logo: S3 mark SVG, viewBox 960x1528. The 'S' path is filled #0E153E and the superscript '3' path is filled #BD2025. It is shown 30px tall with auto width (about 19px) in the phone header; the desktop board shows it 34px tall inside the main bar.
Avatar: 36x36 circle, background #0E153E, white 'DC' initials at 13px/800.

Badge dot (Sharing): 8x8, radius 12px, background #BD2025, 2px border in the surface color oklch(0.998 0.002 275) to cut it out of the icon. Position absolute top 7px, right 16px (desktop uses top 6px, right 14px).
Pill 'Synergy': 12px/700, padding 3px 9px, radius 12px, background oklch(0.93 0.03 275), color #0E153E.
Dark theme: none. No dark values, media query or data-theme exist on the phone board. The desktop main bar has a 'Theme' button, but no dark tokens are defined anywhere in the boards read.
layout_system:
PHONE FRAME: one 390 x 844 px artboard, position relative, overflow hidden. The dot-grid canvas background is painted on this frame. There is NO 12-column grid on phone: widgets stack in ONE column. The HTML comment says "scrolling canvas: widgets stack in one column".

CANVAS COLUMN: an inner div with box-sizing border-box, height 100%, overflow hidden (static mockup; the intended behaviour is vertical scroll), padding 56px 20px 0, display flex, flex-direction column, gap 20px. Content width is 350px (390 − 2×20 gutter). Every widget is full width (350px) and its height is content-driven. The 72px row-unit and the span-3 heights of the desktop grid are not used.

VERTICAL ORDER and measured position (from the screenshot, y in CSS px):
(0) header row at y≈56–92: S3 logo link on the left, 'DC' avatar on the right, justify space-between, align center.
(1) 'Start a routine', y≈112–312 (≈200 tall).
(2) 'Insight · Week 41', SELECTED, y≈334–514 (≈180 tall).
(3) 'Credits & tier', y≈536–≈650, partly covered by the sheet from y≈624.
(4) 'Recent routines': its single row 'Flight briefing' peeks between the sheet and the main bar at y≈740–758 and is otherwise hidden behind the bars.

The phone order differs from desktop, which runs Start(7 cols) · Tier(5) / Recent(4) · Insight(4) · Partners(4) / Report(3) · Rewards(5) · free 4×3 slot. On phone, Insight is promoted to second place. Consented partners, My report, Rewards catalog and the dashed '4 × 3 free · drop a widget here' slot are ABSENT from the phone markup.

NO SPANS / SIZES on phone: there is no S/M/L/XL resize. The phone sheet has no Resize tool, and each widget shows a reduced content set compared with desktop (see widgets).

NO SNAPPING, DRAG OR RESIZE affordances beyond the 6-dot drag-handle glyph in every widget header. The phone has no free-cell placeholder.

OVERLAYS (absolutely positioned inside the frame, floating over the canvas):
(a) CONTEXT SHEET, aria-label 'Selected widget tools': left 20px, right 20px (350 wide), bottom 104px. It is about 116px tall: 12px top padding, 32px header row, 8px gap, 52px tool row, 10px bottom padding, 2px of borders. Its top sits at y≈624. The HTML comment reads "CONTEXT SHEET for the selected widget (left bar becomes a sheet above the main bar)".
(b) MAIN BAR, nav aria-label 'Dashboard': left 20px, right 20px, bottom 20px. It is 66px tall: 6px padding, 52px buttons, 1px borders. It spans y≈758–824. The HTML comment reads "MAIN BAR: stays at the bottom, Start is the big one".
There is an 18px vertical gap between the sheet's bottom edge (104px from frame bottom) and the main bar's top edge (86px from frame bottom).

INNER GEOMETRY: the main bar's inner width is 336px. The 56px Start button is followed by 4 flex:1 buttons of about 68px each, with a 2px gap. The sheet tool grid uses grid-template-columns repeat(5, minmax(0,1fr)) with a 6px gap; inner width is 324px, so each cell is about 60px wide and min-height 52px.

The canvas has NO bottom padding or scroll inset, so the last widgets sit underneath the sheet and main bar. An implementation needs bottom scroll padding of about 220px with the sheet open and about 106px without it, plus safe-area insets. The 56px top padding stands in for the status bar.

BREAKPOINT RELATIONSHIP: this board is the ≤390px phone rendition of the desktop canvas; its board caption is 'Phone · same widgets, bars adapt'. The desktop board CSS has different responsive rules. At max-width 1180px it uses 6 columns: .c7/.c5 span 6 and .c4/.c3 span 3, and the right rail is dropped. At max-width 720px it uses 1 column: the context bar moves to the TOP row as a horizontal wrapping strip with its header at flex 1 1 100% and buttons 4.3em wide, and the main bar goes to row 3, stretched, with a 4px gap. That desktop ≤720px behaviour CONFLICTS with this phone board, which puts the context sheet at the BOTTOM, floating above a fixed main bar. Desktop toolbars also scale by ratio (1em = clamp(10px, 0.9vw, 13px)), which the phone board does not use: its sizes are fixed px.
chrome: TOP HEADER ROW (phone only; replaces the desktop main bar's logo slot and account button). Flex row, align center, justify space-between, inside the canvas column at y≈56. LEFT: wrapping at 30px tall, auto width, display block. RIGHT: avatar 36x36, radius 999px, background #0E153E, white 'DC' at 13px/800. The avatar is a non-interactive span, not a button. On desktop the equivalent is a button with aria-label 'Account: Dana Cohen, Captain' showing the DC avatar, 'Dana' at 13px/800 and 'Captain' at 11px muted.

CONTEXT SHEET (the desktop LEFT/contextual bar, adapted). <div aria-label="Selected widget tools">, position absolute, left 20px, right 20px, bottom 104px, flex column, gap 8px, padding 12px 12px 10px, background oklch(0.998 0.002 275), 1px border oklch(0.9 0.012 275), radius 12px, shadow 0 10px 30px rgba(14,21,62,0.14). It is visible because a widget (Insight) is selected.

CONTEXT SHEET header row: flex, align center, space-between, gap 8px. Left: span at 12px/800 with text 'Widget' (inner span uppercase, letter-spacing 0.06em, color #0E153E, so it renders 'WIDGET') followed by ' · Insight · Week 41' (renders as 'WIDGET · Insight · Week 41'). Right: button aria-label 'Deselect', 32x32 circle (radius 999px), 1px border oklch(0.9 0.012 275), transparent background, muted color, 16px X icon at stroke-width 2. It replaces the desktop 'Esc' tool button.

CONTEXT SHEET tool row: a 5-column grid with a 6px gap. Each cell is a button: flex column, centered, gap 3px, min-height 52px, padding 6px 2px, radius 12px, no border, 20px icon over a 10px/700 label. None of these buttons has an aria-label; the visible text is the name.
Sheet tool 1: 'Confirm'. PRIMARY: background #BD2025, color #fff, check icon at stroke-width 2. Desktop guide meaning: 'Mark it read, +10 credits, once per week.'
Sheet tool 2: 'Past'. Transparent background, muted color, clock icon. Desktop meaning: 'Browse earlier insights.'
Sheet tool 3: 'Snooze'. Transparent background, muted color, bell icon. Desktop meaning: 'Hide it until next week.'
Sheet tool 4: 'Pin'. Transparent background, muted color, pin icon. Desktop meaning: 'Keep it in place when you auto-arrange.'
Sheet tool 5: 'Hide'. Transparent background, muted color, eye-off icon. Desktop meaning: 'Remove it from the canvas (not from the app).'

Sheet vs desktop left bar: desktop shows kicker 'Widget' and title 'Insight · Week 41' stacked in a 74px-wide vertical bar, then the widget tools (Confirm/Past/Snooze), a 1px divider, then 'Pin', 'Resize', 'Hide' and 'Esc'. The phone flattens this to one line of 5. 'Resize' is DROPPED (single column) and 'Esc' becomes the circular X 'Deselect' in the sheet header. Desktop's nothing-selected state (kicker 'Dashboard', title 'Nothing selected', tools 'Add', 'Arrange', 'Reset', 'Lock') is not drawn on phone.

MAIN BAR (bottom). <nav aria-label="Dashboard">, position absolute, left 20px, right 20px, bottom 20px, flex, align center, space-between, gap 2px, padding 6px, background oklch(0.998 0.002 275), 1px border oklch(0.9 0.012 275), radius 12px, shadow 0 10px 30px rgba(14,21,62,0.10). The comment says 'stays at the bottom, Start is the big one'.

Main bar button 1: Start. Button aria-label 'Start routine', ICON-ONLY with no visible label. 56x52, radius 12px, no border, background #BD2025, color #fff, 22px filled play icon. On desktop it is a red pill with play icon plus text 'Start routine' (44px tall, 14px/800). Desktop on-click selects the Start a routine widget (pickStart).

Main bar button 2: 'History'. flex:1, 52px tall, radius 12px, transparent, muted color, 22px clock icon over a 10px/700 label. Desktop on-click selects Recent routines (pickRecent). Desktop guide: 'Every routine you generated, with its action cards.'

Main bar button 3: 'Sharing'. Same style with the 22px users icon, plus a BADGE: an 8x8 #BD2025 dot with a 2px surface-color border at absolute top 7px, right 16px (the button is position relative). Desktop on-click selects Consented partners (pickPartners). Desktop guide: 'Partners who consented to blind synergy; a dot means a pending request.' Desktop data has 1 pending (Noa P.).
Main bar button 4: 'Rewards'. Same style with the 22px award icon. Desktop on-click selects Rewards catalog (pickRewards).
Main bar button 5: 'More'. aria-label 'More', same style with 3 filled dots at 22px. It is phone-only and replaces the desktop items that are missing on phone.

Desktop main bar items with NO visible place on phone (presumably moved under 'More', though this is not specified): 'Report' (upload icon), 'Add' (aria-label 'Add widget', plus icon), 'Layout' (aria-label 'Arrange layout', 2x2 grid icon), 'Search' (aria-label 'Search', magnifier), 'Theme' (aria-label 'Appearance', moon icon), 'Guide' (aria-label 'Open the guide', help-circle icon), the 'Org admin' link (users icon, href Admin.dc.html), the vertical 1px x 28px dividers, and the Account button. The logo and avatar moved to the top header row.

No top app bar, title, search field or tab bar exists other than the header row and the two floating bars above. Hover rules (.tool:hover / .main:hover background oklch(0.975 0.006 275)) exist only on desktop. The phone defines no pressed or active state for any button.

interactions: IMPLEMENTATION STATUS: the phone board itself is NON-interactive. renderVals() returns {}, there are no on-click bindings and no state, and everything is drawn in one frozen state: Insight selected with its sheet open. The interactions below come from the markup semantics (aria-labels, comments) and from the desktop board's logic, which the phone caption says it mirrors ('same widgets, bars adapt').

SELECT: tap a widget's header button (aria-label 'Select widget: Start a routine' / 'Select widget: Weekly insight' / 'Select widget: Credits and tier' / 'Select widget: Recent routines'). This draws the 2px #0E153E inset ring on that widget and shows the CONTEXT SHEET above the main bar, with the header 'WIDGET · <widget title>' and that widget's tools: primary first (red), then Pin and Hide. Only one widget can be selected at a time (desktop state.selected is a single key).

DESELECT: the circular X button (aria-label 'Deselect') in the sheet header replaces the desktop 'Esc' tool. Desktop clear = select 'none'. Keyboard Esc is named in desktop copy ('Esc · Deselect.') but no key listener exists in any board. With nothing selected on phone the sheet is presumably hidden. Desktop shows the 'Dashboard / Nothing selected' tools Add, Arrange, Reset, Lock instead, and no phone equivalent is drawn.

MAIN BAR: Start (red, icon-only, aria 'Start routine') starts a routine; on desktop it selects the Start widget (pickStart). History selects Recent routines (pickRecent). Sharing selects Consented partners (pickPartners) and shows a red dot when a request is pending. Rewards selects Rewards catalog (pickRewards). More is phone-only, with no defined contents.

ROUTINE CHIPS: static spans on phone. On desktop, tapping a chip sets the routine (flight/simulator/training/debrief/coaching), selects the Start widget, and changes the partner line ('Partner for {{routineLabel}}: …').

LINKS: logo leads to 'Phone.dc.html' (aria 'S3 home'), meaning home or dashboard. The Recent row 'Flight briefing' leads to 'Phone.dc.html', the session placeholder. Both are placeholders for the prototype's own page.
DRAG / REORDER: a 6-dot drag-handle glyph is in every header. Desktop guide copy: 'Drag a widget by its title bar to move it.' No touch drag, long-press or move up/down is specified for phone.
RESIZE: deliberately absent on phone (no Resize tool; single-column layout).
